reference_role: identity and costume reference; adult proportions corrected in assembly

sources.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent character rig texture atlas, body and arms, for a custom browser VTuber teacher.
Input image 1 is the identity and costume reference. Input image 2 is the previous body atlas, to be CORRECTED.
Primary request: produce a clean, polished new BODY ATLAS of this same adult Japanese anime teacher. Preserve brown hair identity in reference, navy wool blazer with delicate gold botanical lapel embroidery, ivory blouse, sage silk bow and pearl-gold brooch. The body must have natural adult proportions, a normal broad shoulder girdle, moderate bust, comfortable waist, long enough torso and normal adult arms. Soft warm light from upper left, restrained fabric highlights.
Atlas layout: portrait canvas, six separate isolated tiles, two columns and three rows, generous fully transparent gutters, no labels.
TOP LEFT: headless and ARMLESS torso only, from open blouse collar through hips. This is a sleeveless rig base: navy jacket has smooth shoulder caps ending immediately at the shoulder sockets, absolutely NO painted upper arms, sleeves, elbows, forearms or hands along the sides. Paint the chest and side seams cleanly beneath where animated arms will overlap. The collar opening is truly transparent (no neck skin). Keep the jacket/front blouse and sage bow complete, normal adult anatomy, avoid tiny waist.
TOP RIGHT: back hair and brown ponytail, isolated, matching this teacher.
MIDDLE LEFT and MIDDLE RIGHT: left and right complete navy jacket sleeves, shoulder cap to elbow to ivory wrist cuff, NO HANDS. Each arm is long, naturally proportioned and only gently bent inward about 15 degrees, not a sharp right angle. Normal cloth thickness, connected elbow, broad rounded shoulder cap, relaxed folds. Entire continuous sleeve visible with plenty of transparent padding. Sleeve end cuff has a clean skin opening ready for a hand.
BOTTOM LEFT: one beautiful adult hand offering a small palm-up teaching gesture, includes a short natural wrist, no clothes, believable five fingers.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one adult RIGHT hand relaxed on a horizontal desk, seen obliquely from the front and slightly above, back of hand visible, palm down, fingers naturally relaxed and pointing diagonally down-left toward the viewer. This is a DESK-REST hand, foreshortened, not dangling vertically. Include wrist on upper right and soft natural finger curvature. No desk drawn.
Constraints: same detailed semi-realistic Japanese anime illustration quality as the reference, cohesive warm skin, clean anti-aliased cutout edges, genuine alpha transparency throughout every empty area. No background, gradient, glow, drop shadow, text, watermark, reference character duplicate or props. Do not paint attached sleeves on the torso tile.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent FACE AND HAIR ATLAS for the same adult VTuber teacher.
Reference image 1 is the teacher's costume and identity. Reference image 2 is the existing face atlas layout.
Primary request: refine this same woman into a graceful mature adult Japanese anime teacher with natural facial proportions. Preserve brown layered ponytail, fine silver oval glasses, sage-green eyes, small gold flower hairpin and pearl stud earrings. Retain her approachable quiet smile and soft warm left-hand classroom lighting. Reduce oversized glossy eye openings a little, give the midface a natural nose bridge and the jaw a softly rounded adult shape; avoid a sharply pointed doll chin, heavy makeup or plastic shine.
Create exactly nine isolated parts on a transparent canvas, same THREE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS layout as image 2:
TOP LEFT: complete bald skin base, front facing, face, ears with pearl studs, short natural neck and collarbones; nose painted, but NO eyes, brows, mouth, hair or glasses. Maintain anatomically plausible adult head and short neck.
TOP CENTER: complete front brown hair framing the face with separate cutout face opening; brown side ponytail and small gold flower pin, intricate individual strands. Match the bald face shape at the same scale.
TOP RIGHT: fine silver oval glasses alone, matching adult face width and eyes, transparent lenses with subtle reflection.
MIDDLE LEFT: paired natural almond-shaped open sage-green eyes alone, restrained size, delicate lashes, little surrounding feathered skin.
MIDDLE CENTER: paired brown eyebrows alone.
MIDDLE RIGHT: paired softly closed eyelids alone with minimal surrounding feathered skin.
BOTTOM LEFT: softly closed neutral smiling mouth alone.
BOTTOM CENTER: same mouth open for speaking an A, modest opening, teeth and tongue visible naturally.
BOTTOM RIGHT: same mouth softly rounded for an O, restrained opening.
All skin and hair shading must match the same face. Each paired feature has correct bilateral spacing. No facial feature is painted onto the blank skin base. No labels, text, watermark, background gradient, glow or shadows in the empty gutters. Genuinely transparent alpha in every empty area and clean feathered antialiasing on the edges. This atlas will be cut into real animation layers, keep generous gaps between all parts.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: isolated sleeves and desk-rest hand atlas for this same adult anime teacher.
Input image is the exact costume and identity reference; preserve navy woven blazer fabric, modest gold cuff buttons and ivory inner cuffs. Warm gentle light from upper left, polished detailed Japanese anime illustration.
Primary request: four isolated transparent tiles in a two by two atlas, portrait orientation, no labels, generous empty gutters.
TOP LEFT: one entire left blazer sleeve from rounded shoulder socket to elbow to wrist cuff. TOP RIGHT: matching right sleeve. The sleeves are laid out almost STRAIGHT VERTICALLY from shoulder at the top through elbow in the middle to cuff at the bottom, with only a very slight inward bend. Natural slim adult upper arm and forearm, small ordinary shoulder cap, no puff sleeves, no balloon shoulder or elbow bunch. Sleeve length is about five times its widest upper arm width. Normal garment ease, subtle longitudinal fabric folds. Each sleeve is continuous and has a clean complete ivory cuff, no hand and no torso.
BOTTOM LEFT: the back of an adult right hand resting gently palm down on a horizontal desk, viewed from seated conversation height, frontal and slightly above. Wrist on upper right, fingers relaxed diagonally toward lower left. Use strong natural foreshortening so the palm and fingers form a compact low profile hand with a roughly landscape footprint, not a long dangling hand. Five anatomically clean fingers, natural nails, no costume, no desk.
BOTTOM RIGHT: same hand in a restrained palm-up explaining gesture, fingers relaxed, include short wrist, no sleeve or desk.
Constraints: genuine transparent background and gutters, no gradient, halo, props, full character, detached clothing fragments, labels or watermark. These become animated rig layers; do not add hair, face, blouse or extra objects. Normal connected human anatomy, slim natural sleeves, clean anti-aliased edges.

iteration_notes: First v3 assembly rejected: duplicate rear head, doubled ear, balloon sleeves and dangling hand orientation.

Second v3 assembly uses a separate near-straight sleeve atlas; omits the rear-view head, aligns front hair with the face and glasses, preserves source aspect ratios, and registers palm-down desk-rest hands.
design_limits: Front-facing custom 2D mesh with restrained motion, not a Cubism model.
